title: Precomputed place statistics
description: Precomputed statistics of ERDDAP grid variables over the gazetteer places: one Parquet file per (dataset, variable, place), covering the dataset's full record. A long backfill fills in over several daily runs, so each item link and Item says how far it has got in erddap-places:status (complete: from the first time step; partial: a later start, still being backfilled), and erddap-places:pending lists the targets with no file yet. Each file is produced by exactly the code the browser app runs live — the place polygon masks the dataset's own grid (cell centre inside, partial-area weight on the boundary) and sql/stats_daily.sql or sql/stats_categorical.sql aggregates per day — so a precomputed row and a live in-browser row agree. Use these when you want the answer now; run the live query when you want today. An Item's gazetteer:collection names the gazetteer collection its place came from (places for the 18 sanctuaries listed here); places of other collections are precomputed on request and have an Item and a file, but no entry in this collection.
